text: Mi nuh know if dis is foolishness but mi a ask anyway. Mi granddaughter, she 22 months, temperature reach 40 tonight. She have di runny belly, poo watery from dis mornin, but she drinkin good still, she tek her bottle an some water no problem. Only ting is mi check her nappy an it dry, it dry from early, mi count an is more dan 12 hours now she nuh wee at all. Mi did tink she would wee wid all di drinkin. Maybe mi a fret fi nutten, mi nuh know, her mada at work.
